The range

Bathroom vanities: wall hung, freestanding and slimline

Most vanity units are sold as a cabinet, with a choice of tops, so you can match the cabinet to the basin style you want. Slimline cabinets with a reduced depth are listed for narrow bathrooms and ensuites.

Wall hung vanities

A wall hung vanity is fixed to the wall and leaves the floor clear. There are 344 on this page, in plain, fluted and curved fronts.

Freestanding vanities

A freestanding vanity stands on a kickboard or on legs. There are 150 on this page.

Vanity tops and basins

106 tops are listed in ceramic, poly, solid surface, quartz and sintered stone. Some tops have the basin moulded in. Others are cut for a basin to match.

How do wall hung and freestanding vanities compare?

Wall hung vanityFreestanding vanity
StorageDrawers or cupboards above a clear floorUsually a little more, as the cabinet runs to the floor or sits on legs
CleaningThe floor underneath can be moppedA kickboard closes the gap. Legs leave a gap to clean under
PlumbingSuits a waste that comes out of the wallSuits a waste that comes up through the floor, and hides it
FixingNeeds solid fixing into the wall frameStands on the floor and is fixed back to the wall
LookLight and modern, and makes a small room feel largerTraditional and solid

Pricing

Vanity prices and what changes them

6 vanities show their price on this site, from $290 to $2,618. The Sunny White 600, for example, is $290 to $440, depending on the cabinet material and whether you add the ceramic top.

Four things change the price of a vanity: the width, the cabinet material, the top, and the finish. The Otti and Poseidon ranges show Enquire Now, and the team confirms the price for the size and top you choose.

Widths

Choosing a width, from 600 to 1800

Measure the wall, then allow room for the door swing and the toilet beside it. A 600mm vanity suits an ensuite or a small bathroom. A 900mm vanity suits most main bathrooms, and a 1200mm vanity gives one person generous bench space or takes two basins.

A double vanity with two bowls is listed at 1200 and 1500 wide. For powder rooms there are compact 400 mm units as well.

Tops

Stone top, ceramic top or cabinet only

A ceramic top has the basin moulded in, so there is no join to seal and it is the simplest to keep clean. A stone, quartz or sintered top is a flat slab that takes an above counter or undermount basin, and gives more bench space.

Buying the cabinet only lets you choose the top separately. Check that the top is the same width and depth as the cabinet, and whether it is drilled for a tap hole.

Availability

Vanity availability and order times

With 653 vanities across many widths and colours, availability is checked for each order. Send the product name, the width and the colour, and the team confirms what can be supplied and when.

Order the vanity before the plumbing rough-in if you can, so your plumber can set the waste and water to suit it.

How to buy

Measure up, choose, enquire

Measure the wall width, the depth from the wall to where a door or shower screen opens, and the height of any window sill. Note whether the waste comes out of the wall or up through the floor.

Choose the cabinet, then the top, then a mixer for your basin. Finish the wall above with mirrors and shaving cabinets in the same width, and add everything to one enquiry.

Warranty

Vanity warranty

Vanities carry their maker's warranty, and the terms depend on the cabinet material. The PVC Space Saving 600 Vanity, for example, is listed with a 7 year warranty against water damage to the cabinetry and 12 months on fittings and accessories.

Ask us for the warranty terms of the vanity you choose. Sealing the top to the wall and wiping up standing water both help a cabinet last.

Delivery

Delivery and pick-up for vanities

Pick up from the Bonnyrigg showroom, or ask about delivery. We deliver across Sydney metro. A boxed 1500 or 1800 vanity is long and heavy, so bring a ute or van and a second person if you are collecting.

Vanities are one part of the range: we deliver bathroom supplies Sydney metro wide, including back to wall and rimless toilets.

Ranges

Otti and Poseidon vanity ranges

Otti Australia supplies 145 vanities on this page, in ranges including Byron, Bondi, Havana, Laguna, Hampshire, Hampton and Marlo. Most are wall hung, many with fluted or curved fronts.

The Poseidon and KDK Home ranges make up the rest, including Ceto, Vito, Berge, Polar, Nordic, Nova, Evie and Acacia, with PVC, plywood and wood grain MDF cabinets and the matching tops.

Care

Cleaning a vanity top and cabinet

Wipe the top and the cabinet with a soft damp cloth and a mild detergent, then dry it. Avoid abrasive cleaners, bleach and solvent on polyurethane, PVC film and stone surfaces.

Do not leave water sitting on the edges of drawers and doors, and keep the room ventilated so the cabinet dries between showers.

Vanities

Vanity questions

What is a vanity?

A vanity is the bathroom cabinet that holds the basin. It hides the plumbing, gives you storage and provides a bench around the basin. It is sold as a cabinet with a top, or as a cabinet only.

How tall is a bathroom vanity?

Most bathroom vanities finish between about 850 and 900 mm from the floor to the top. The Sunny White vanities on this page, for example, are listed at 890 mm high. A wall hung vanity can be fixed at the height that suits you.

Where can I buy a bathroom vanity in Sydney?

You can buy a bathroom vanity in Sydney from Bonnyrigg Tiles. Enquire on this site, call (02) 8786 0288 or visit the showroom. Showroom: 43-45 Bonnrigg Avenue, Bonnyrigg NSW 2177.

Is a wall hung or freestanding vanity better?

Neither is better for every bathroom. A wall hung vanity keeps the floor clear and suits a waste in the wall. A freestanding vanity hides a floor waste and usually gives a little more storage.

How much does a bathroom vanity cost?

The vanities with a price on this site run from $290 to $2,618, depending on the width, the material and the top. Other ranges show Enquire Now and are priced when you enquire.

Do vanities come with the top and basin?

Some do and some do not. Many vanities are listed as cabinet only, with the top chosen separately. Check the product name and options, which state whether the top is included.

acceptedAnswer.text: A vanity is the bathroom cabinet that holds the basin. It hides the plumbing, gives you storage and provides a bench around the basin. It is sold as a cabinet with a top, or as a cabinet only.

mainEntity.name: How tall is a bathroom vanity?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most bathroom vanities finish between about 850 and 900 mm from the floor to the top. The Sunny White vanities on this page, for example, are listed at 890 mm high. A wall hung vanity can be fixed at the height that suits you.

mainEntity.name: Where can I buy a bathroom vanity in Sydney?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can buy a bathroom vanity in Sydney from Bonnyrigg Tiles. Enquire on this site, call (02) 8786 0288 or visit the showroom. Showroom: 43-45 Bonnrigg Avenue, Bonnyrigg NSW 2177.

mainEntity.name: Is a wall hung or freestanding vanity better?

acceptedAnswer.text: Neither is better for every bathroom. A wall hung vanity keeps the floor clear and suits a waste in the wall. A freestanding vanity hides a floor waste and usually gives a little more storage.

mainEntity.name: How much does a bathroom vanity cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The vanities with a price on this site run from $290 to $2,618, depending on the width, the material and the top. Other ranges show Enquire Now and are priced when you enquire.

mainEntity.name: Do vanities come with the top and basin?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some do and some do not. Many vanities are listed as cabinet only, with the top chosen separately. Check the product name and options, which state whether the top is included.
